a drag on the rail stops playback and puts the clock under the pointer

checks.expected: a theme stops the clock (app.js's dwell comment; the spine data task: a theme opens on its principal moment)
3 s after choosing a theme the clock is still at its moment
the dwell off, its button not pressed, the panel closed
with the dwell off, Play runs at ½× (5 clock min a second) through the starts without a stop
PageDown during Play stops at a phase start (dwell off)
the dwell turned on while playing: the clock never goes back; the first start ahead dwells (S-2 fixed)
the dwell turned off in a hold: the clock leaves the start at once at ½×
4× pressed 10 frames into a hold: the hold keeps its 1.5 s (45 frames in all), the ease out and the run after it at 4× (40 clock min a second)
½× pressed in an ease in at 4×: the clock's step drops at once by the ratio and eases on into the hold (8H)
2× pressed in an ease out: no backward step; after it, 2× (20 clock min a second)
the last speed pressed stands
